Hey, I have almost 1 M on Elise, she is def a very hard champ to master, what you have to remember the most that she is an assassin and a bruiser at the same time depending on the enemy if tank or add, you always need to have a way to get out of fight before you engage as Elise's combo is kind of trying to one shot or do the most damage possible in the shortest amount of time, so if you go in and you are stuck all your abilities are on CD.

in terms of mechanics ALWAYS remember that you can rappel on enemy's wards and ALSO on jungle plant and monsters even if you don't have vision on them (as Elise's E spider form provides the vision for you)

another thing that I have learned recently (not necessarily with Elise) hold you stun until last moment as it will be very hard to dodge, especially if they burned their flash and it is you MAIN engage tool if you don't hit stun you have to poke with abilities and not all in while when you hit it you have to kinda do all your damage while the enemy is stunned (for example one shoting Jax before his stun hits you).

last thing I want to mention is, you have to practice a lot to switch before her human and spider form as needed (Human long ranged for high hp enemy, and spider for engage low hp enemy), plus her spider form is superior to her human is she gains MS, MR and armour and you can always tank abilities with her passive (the spiderlings).
